scripts.build: bun --bun vite build && bun scripts/build-worker.mjs && bun run typecheck
scripts.lint: bun --bun biome check . --error-on-warnings && uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check .
scripts.format: bun --bun biome check --write . && uv run --locked ruff check --fix . && uv run --locked ruff format .
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.verify: bun run build && bun run check && bun test tests
